ATTACHMENT 1

Resource – Assignment Details: 25DV06 – QCHEM Audit

Number of Resources required 4 Category 1- General Auditor 2 -Technical Auditor 3 - IT Auditor Category 1- General Auditor (1 Auditor) Category 2- Technical Auditor (3 Auditors) Dates Required Fieldwork phase: 04 – 29 May 2025 No. of Working Days 80 Man days (20 Days for each resource) Location Doha, Mesaieed and Ras Laffan HSE – type of HSE Office based and Site Safety. Data Confidentiality – list any specific requirements Contractor shall not discuss or share any information related to the assignment and obtained during the Audit with any other person outside of the Company Audit Team. Scope of Services: To participate as an Auditor in the Company Internal Audit . The objective of the audit is to provide independent assurance to the shareholders on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and control processes, including the following Audit areas: Governance Risk Management Corporate Strategic Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Supply Chain and Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety Maintenance

Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management IT / OT Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments and Project Management Services required: Perform audit work in accordance with Company internal auditing standards and IIA Standards. Review, understand and execute the audit program to meet the audit objectives. Document the audit testing results in a timely manner, with high quality and adequate working papers (using templates provided). Audit findings/observations to be well documented in Audit Memos with adequate supporting documentation. Discuss and agree the potential observations / gaps identified with the Lead Auditor on a timely basis. Discuss and agree with the auditee/client the agreed observations / gaps Document Audit Memos (within 2 days from their identification and agreement) and have them approved by the Lead Auditor. Audit Areas to be covered The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate Strategic Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Technical Auditor: Supply Chain and Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety

Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments and Project Management

Resource - Required skills:

Skill / Competence Area Specification Input by Service Provider [Please note: Simple Yes or No responses are not sufficient] Mandatory / Preferred / Desirable Minimum years of experience 5 years in auditing experience. M University Qualifications Mandatory - A bachelor’s degree M University Qualifications A bachelor’s degree in business administration /finance for Category 1 - General Auditor A bachelor’s degree in engineering for Category 2 - Technical Auditor M Professional Qualifications Preferable - Auditing certification is beneficial. P Professional Qualifications Desirable - Valid membership of a relevant professional body (e.g. The Institute of Internal Auditors) Include a list of relevant courses attended. D Experience Areas Prior experience in Business / Finance Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 1 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: P

General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate	Strategic	Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts Prior experience in Engineering Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 2 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Technical Auditor: Supply	Chain	and	Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments	and	Project Management Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. M

Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. M Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. M
